name: 7592-chunkedprefill-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of one a3 node).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process engine. Topology is not a free parameter here: widening it spreads the pinned KV pool over more cards.
architecture: dense decoder (Qwen2ForCausalLM), bf16, 7.62B parameters, ~15.2 GB of weights, 28 layers, 28 query heads / 4 KV heads, head_dim 128, 32768-token context.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 512 streams, warmup 30% and cooldown 10% both counted in REQUESTS, bounded at 2000 requests with an 1800 s safety cap -- 1200 measured requests.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, `request_format: plain` (no chat template), one fixed shape: every request is exactly 512 prompt tokens and exactly 512 output tokens, min = max on both. No prefix buckets, no length distribution, no shared prefix. No `sampling_params` are declared, so temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0 and `ignore_eos` apply and every request emits exactly 512 tokens.
purpose: A 7B assistant drafting fixed 512-token replies to 512-token prompts for 512 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.5.5-era `AsyncEngineArgs`: it takes a fixed field set, so an unknown key is a TypeError
# at engine construction rather than a warning. Do not add keys from a later vLLM.
model: Qwen/Qwen2-7B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 1

dtype: bfloat16

max-model-len: 10000

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# No CUDA graphs.
enforce-eager: true

enable-chunked-prefill: true

max-num-batched-tokens: 256
max-num-seqs: 256

# Pins the KV pool independently of card size: 6784 x 16 tokens per block = 108544 tokens.
num-gpu-blocks-override: 6784
